jobs.title: Senior Backend Engineer
jobs.content: <p>Acme Robotics builds warehouse automation for regional grocers. The backend team owns the fleet-coordination services that keep two thousand robots moving without collisions.</p><h3>What you'll do</h3><ul><li>Own the scheduling service end to end</li><li>Design APIs used by the fleet controllers</li></ul><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>5+ years building backend services in Go or Python</li><li>Experience operating PostgreSQL at scale</li><li>Comfortable with on-call rotations</li></ul><h3>Nice to have</h3><ul><li>Robotics or logistics domain experience</li><li>Familiarity with gRPC</li></ul><p>This role is only open to candidates located in the United States.</p><p>The salary range for this position is USD 140,000 - 170,000 per year, plus equity.</p>

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.content: <p>Acme Robotics is hiring a Data Analyst for our Berlin office to turn fleet telemetry into decisions the operations team can act on.</p><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>3+ years of SQL and dashboarding experience</li><li>Working knowledge of Python for data analysis</li></ul><h3>Benefits</h3><ul><li>Competitive compensation</li><li>Public transport pass</li></ul>

jobs.title: Product Designer
jobs.content: <p>Join Acme Robotics as a Product Designer for the operator console used on warehouse floors around the world.</p><h3>Requirements</h3><ul><li>Portfolio of shipped B2B interfaces</li><li>Experience running usability studies</li></ul><p>Compensation: $90,000 - $110,000 per year depending on experience.</p>
